semantics.replay: Exact last60 authored demand dates, fulfilled values and censoring. Thermometer values are arithmetic means of four independent dated authored observations, computed in Python. They are not continuous real-room history.
semantics.fit_history: 19 projections of existing saved calibration artifacts; as-of dates are synthetic replay dates, not actual training execution dates.
semantics.pinn: Original artifact except network weights; includes exact original training and full validation evidence. Actual inference weights remain unchanged in the audited runtime.
semantics.backtest: Optional newly computed past-only fits and paired28-day-mean baseline on60 synthetic days. These are not saved daily operational accuracy or daily Q/PINN training.
semantics.chart_adaptation: Pure rendering, root-only actual MCTS inspection. Two local display corrections suppress irrelevant Q missing text for PINN-only and retain tiny nonzero numbers in scientific notation.
